thread:
karen_cs: Onboard check for Zephyr Labs POC. They see repeated 401 then a spike in 429s during init warmup. Failures appear ~25s after cold start. Can eng take a look?
tyler_eng: can you paste the exact request they use for warmup and any logs? 401->429 often token TTL overlap + fanout.
karen_cs: Warmup snippet from their Node sidecar: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <short_lived>
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"rwd-embed-2b","input":"ping"}
```
They rotate every 30s. After ~6 parallel warmup calls we start seeing 401s then sustained 429s for ~90s.
metrics-bot: Alert: zephyr-poc key (client: zph-007) 5m 429 rate jumped 1% -> 42% at 3334567112. Top route: /v1/embeddings.
anya_se: quick hypothesis: preflight/ephemeral overlap causing stale or missing Authorization on some requests -> 401; concurrent retries then hit soft per-key throttling -> 429 burst.
tyler_eng: short-term customer fixes: 1) cache tokens per worker for >=75s; 2) add jittered backoff on 401 responses; 3) reduce warmup parallelism (try maxParallel=3). Example Node config: 
```
const client = new Redwood({
  tokenProvider: cachedTokenProvider, // cache 75s per process
  maxParallelRequests: 3,
  authRetry: { attempts: 4, baseDelayMs: 150, jitter: true }
});
```
karen_cs: attached logs show 
[09:11:02] POST /v1/embeddings 401 invalid_token
[09:11:03] POST /v1/embeddings 401 Authorization: missing
[09:11:04] POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit_exceeded
[09:11:05] POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit_exceeded

anya_se: If they can't change client quickly, we can consider a temporary mitigation on our side: raise soft concurrency for zph-007 by +2 for 2 hours and add a 30s token-grace window. Ops approval required.
jeff_ae: FYI renewal at risk if POC stalls >48h. Please prioritize.
karen_cs: Plan: share SDK snippet now, ask them to deploy to staging and run 50 sequential warmups (no parallel), report 429 rate after 20m. If >20% we escalate to ops for temporary cap bump. Actions: Karen -> customer note + call; Tyler -> ops escalation draft; Anya -> short doc on warmup debounce.
